brief.en: Digs back and forth and damages zombies that step on them
brief.zh: 在地面上来回移动，对经过的僵尸造成伤害

description.en: Bambooshoots dig back and forth on the ground, damaging zombies that step on them.
description.zh: 竹笋在地面上来回移动，对经过的僵尸造成伤害。

chat.en: Bambooshoot learned Earth Traversal from Tu Xingsun. After years of grinding (literally), he got his "Underground Degree" in Tunnel Engineering.
chat.zh: 竹笋从土行孙那里习得地行术功夫, 又经过不懈努力, 终于获得“钻头工程学院”学土学位。
